title: CMB power spectrum row
description: One binned multipole of the CMB angular power spectrum from Planck 2018 VI. Single row_type catalogue ('multipole_bin'); each row records the bin center ℓ, the bin half-width Δℓ, the power D_ℓ = ℓ(ℓ+1)C_ℓ/(2π) in μK² (the standard published form), the 1-σ error on D_ℓ, the spectrum kind (TT, TE, or EE), and a feature label identifying the row's role in the acoustic-peak structure.

ell_bin_label.description: Stable identifier for this binned multipole (e.g. 'TT_ell0220_first_peak'). Used in cite_as / purpose templates.

ell_center.description: Central multipole of the bin. Planck 2018 high-ℓ likelihood covers ℓ=30-2508; low-ℓ likelihood covers ℓ=2-29.

ell_half_width.description: Half-width of the multipole bin (so the bin spans [ell_center - half_width, ell_center + half_width]). Low-ℓ rows use half_width = 0 (single ℓ); high-ℓ bins are typically Δℓ ≈ 5-30 depending on bin position.

D_ell_muK2.description: Binned power D_ℓ = ℓ(ℓ+1)C_ℓ/(2π) in units of μK². For TT spectrum this is positive; for TE it can be positive or negative; for EE it is positive but much smaller than TT.

D_ell_error_muK2.description: 1-σ Gaussian error on D_ℓ in μK² (Planck-likelihood-marginalized; combines cosmic variance + instrumental + foreground).

spectrum_kind.description: Which auto/cross spectrum this bin belongs to: TT = temperature-temperature, TE = temperature-E-polarization, EE = E-mode polarization, BB = B-mode (Planck has only upper limits on BB).

feature.description: Qualitative label identifying the row's role in the acoustic-peak structure. 'low_ell_anomaly' covers the well-known suppressed quadrupole / octupole alignment ('Axis of Evil') regime ℓ ∈ [2, 5].

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. First-ship seed rows are 'rounded_2sf' (values quoted to 2 significant figures from Planck 2018 VI Table B.1 / Fig. 1); follow-up ingest of full PR3 Legacy Archive bands will upgrade to 'high'.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — e.g. 'first peak position is one of the most-cited values in cosmology' or 'low-ℓ commander likelihood'.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Planck reference. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833910 (Planck 2018 VI).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional Planck release version, e.g. 'PR3' or 'PR3/R3.01'.
